name: Dots & Devotion
description: A 3BHK apartment interior in Gandhinagar where warm oak millwork, rattan joinery, and hand-crafted detail come together in a palette of cream, ochre, and grain. The living room's dot-relief wall — alternating teak and plaster spheres — serves as both texture and artwork, anchoring the open plan with quiet intention. A large Pattachitra mural in the dining area roots the home in Indian craft tradition, while the bedrooms balance warmth and rest through carved wardrobe inlays and full-height oak panelling.
